title: Ranabaali Trailer Arriving October 8
excerpt: PAN-India period drama starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna releases October 16.
body:
• Mythri Movie Makers announced the Ranabaali trailer arrives October 8.
  • The PAN-India period drama releases October 16, 2026, starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna.
  • Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, with music by Ajay-Atul.

Mythri Movie Makers has announced that the trailer for Ranabaali arrives October 8.

https://x.com/MythriOfficial/status/2107396813284380711

Ranabaali is a 2026 PAN-India film releasing October 16, 2026, starring Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna and Arnold Vosloo. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan with music by Ajay-Atul, it is positioned as a major Diwali-season theatrical release — the Deverakonda–Rashmika pairing makes it one of the most anticipated Telugu-origin films of the fall.
